fields.summary_ko.0: Marvell Technology (NASDAQ:MRVL) declined 6.4% as of November 16 at 1:15 PM ET, impacted by broad semiconductor weakness following Jensen Huang's resignation as Nvidia CEO.
fields.summary_ko.1: Major chip stocks including Micron (MU), Intel (INTC), AMD, and Broadcom (AVGO) also fell more than 4%, as investors exit AI trade pending clearer developments.
fields.summary_ko.2: Marvell announced acquisition of optical component supplier Lumentum (LITE) in $11.5 billion stock deal, adding to stock price pressure from shareholder dilution.
